== AbdulMalik Era ==

'''AbdulMalik Era''' is a Nigerian gaming content creator and streamer known for content related to the mobile video game ''Call of Duty: Mobile'' (CODM). He gained online attention for his masked online identity and TikTok livestream content.

== Career ==

AbdulMalik Era began creating gaming-related content on social media platforms, focusing primarily on ''Call of Duty: Mobile'' gameplay, livestreams, and gaming entertainment content.

He became known online for appearing publicly with a masked identity during livestream sessions and short-form gaming videos. In 2025, several online publications reported on his return to TikTok streaming activity after a period of inactivity.<ref>https://www.24-7pressrelease.com/press-release/527232/masked-codm-streamer-abdulmalikera-makes-dramatic-return-to-tiktok</ref><ref>https://www.newsworthy.ai/curated/masked-codm-streamer-abdulmalik-returns-to-tiktok-with-mystery-d/202521580</ref>

== Online presence ==

AbdulMalik Era is associated with gaming livestreams, TikTok content creation, and the online ''Call of Duty: Mobile'' community. Discussions relating to his online persona and streaming activities have appeared on online forums and social media communities.
